Title: Service discovery
Expected Result: Only supported hooks and active versions are returned.

Title: Hook contract
Test Case Description: Valid medication and patient hooks invoke deterministically.
Test Steps: POST each supported hook with context and prefetch
Expected Result: Cards follow CDS shape with UUID and no PHI links.

Title: Bounded input
Test Case Description: Invalid missing malformed and oversized context is rejected.
Test Steps: POST missing patient malformed prefetch and oversized payloads

Title: Roles and scopes
Test Case Description: Only clinician/admin with permitted scope can invoke and administer.
Test Steps: Invoke and activate as each role/scope
Expected Result: Unauthorized requests are rejected; activation is admin-only.

Title: Deterministic cards
Test Case Description: Trusted P0 rules map to allergy and interaction cards or none.
Pre-Conditions: Synthetic allergy medication and interaction data
Expected Result: Same indicators and cards; no findings yields empty cards.

Title: Severity mapping
Test Case Description: Trusted severity maps to CDS indicator without new safety logic.

Title: Idempotency
Test Case Description: Duplicate invocation key creates one immutable invocation and card set.
Test Steps: Replay same and conflicting request keys
Expected Result: Replay returns same result; conflicting payload is rejected.

Title: Rule lifecycle
Test Case Description: Published rule versions activate retire and stale safely.
Test Steps: Attempt mutation activation retirement and invoke
Expected Result: Published payload is immutable and stale rules do not produce cards.

Title: Card actions
Test Case Description: Accept validates suggestion and routes through normal action boundary.
Expected Result: Only offered suggestion is accepted and no silent chart mutation occurs.

Title: Reason boundaries
Test Case Description: Dismiss safety-critical and override require reasons.
Expected Result: Blank reason rejected; valid action is append-only.

Title: Atomic evidence
Test Case Description: Invocation cards audit and outbox commit or roll back together.

Title: Concurrency
Test Case Description: Concurrent duplicate invocations and card actions remain idempotent.
Expected Result: One invocation and bounded actions with immutable audit evidence.

Title: Failure and timeout
Test Case Description: Local evaluation failures return safe bounded errors.
Expected Result: No clinical writes or unsafe details in response/logs.

Title: Injection redaction
Test Case Description: Hostile context and codes never enter logs URLs or cards.
Test Steps: Submit hostile fields and inspect records/logs
Expected Result: Rejected or redacted; no PHI or control characters leak.

Title: Accessible card UI
Test Case Description: Clinician sees non-clinical warning evidence and accessible card actions.
Test Steps: Run CDS and exercise accept dismiss override
Expected Result: Accessible labels/states and reason boundary are visible.
